how: next build && next start (production, not dev); agent-browser vitals/eval/react renders; DEMO_LATENCY_MS=0
caveats: /_next/mcp exists only under next dev, so get_routes/get_errors/get_compilation_issues ran against next dev, never against next start.
INP is the worst interaction duration from a PerformanceObserver event entry (16 ms is the observer's lower bound), not the web-vitals INP script.
ttfb, lcp, fcp are agent-browser vitals; cold = first load of the route after server start, warm = median of runs 2..N.
Sizes are bytes: html* from the navigation entry, rscPayloadBytes = sum of self.__next_f script payloads in the HTML, snapshotBytes = the permdock Snapshot JSON inside the flight data.
Server read time comes from the DataSource element (Loaded.tookMs); with DEMO_LATENCY_MS=0 the in-memory store reports 0 ms.

Re-recorded on perf/scale-100k: page routes only; the approve, delete and offline entries keep the figures recorded on main at 305c65b because the agent-browser daemon returned EOF during those steps.
notMeasured: Database is the throwaway Postgres 17 container started by scripts/serve.ts (the sample's own stack), not the supabase CLI stack; seed via SEED_QUOTES or scripts/seed-scale.ts.

The sample has no quote detail, approve or delete route, and nothing calls forbidden() or unauthorized(); those states are not measured. denied-staff (Carla on the staff list) and unauthorized (signed out) are the inline Protected states.
get_routes/get_errors/get_compilation_issues were not run for this sample (no dev pass with the container database).
